messages:
maya (infra): Heads-up: proposal for handling transient demand spikes in Dedicated pools—want to avoid overprovisioning while meeting 99th latency SLO. sketch below.

liam (runtime): short question: are we targeting per-tenant SLOs or per-route?

maya (infra): per-tenant SLOs initially, but routes can opt-in. core idea: token-bucket burst credits per tenant backed by reserved capacity + soft burst pool. tenants with Reserved contracts get higher baseline.

sasha (platform): how do burst credits interact with billing? won't we blow committed capacity and charge customer unexpectedly?

omar (prod-eng): ike: we need explicit guardrails: a hard cap on billable GPU-mins/day and a notification webhook for overage. Otherwise finance will kill us.

liam (runtime): implementation sketch: admission logic that checks: 1) tenant credits > 0 or reserved slots available 2) predicted latency if admitted (cheap estimator) 3) if admission fails, fallback to a lower-capacity model variant.

liam (runtime): pseudo:
```
if tenant.burst_tokens > 0 or reserved.available > 0:
  score = estimator.predict(req)
  if score.latency < SLO * 1.2:
    admit()
  else:
    route_to_variant('compact')
else:
  reject_or_queue()
```

kai (sre): need to consider prewarming cost for KV cache; warming a large model is expensive -> prefer admission favoring warm hosts. We should tag nodes with warm_score and prefer them.

maya (infra): agreed. also propose a 'burst_lane' boolean on pools: nodes that accept short-lived burst jobs and tracked for chargeback. admission should prefer warm hosts in burst_lane.

sasha (platform): edge case: many tenants burst simultaneously -> runoff. propose a global burst budget and proportional fairness by committed capacity.

omar (prod-eng): can we model fairness as: each tenant gets burst_share = min(budget * (tenant.commit / total_commit), tenant.max_burst)

liam (runtime): good. also need eviction policy: LIFO for transient requests, don't evict long-running dedicated streams. and fallback degrade gracefully to streaming token-slowdown.

maya (infra): ops checklist for rollout: metrics to add -> per-tenant burst_tokens, burst_admits, warm_host_hits, fallback_rate. alert on >5% fallback for committed customers.

deploy-bot: user maya (infra) updated config 'burst-policy-v2' -> posted canary to eng-runtime at 1829990300 :rocket:

sasha (platform): can we run a smoke with synthetic tenants? plan: 50 tenants, varied commits, random spikes, measure latency tail and total GPU-mins. run next Tue.

kai (sre): will add chaos test for node warm/unavailability. make sure prewarm TTL is honored.

maya (infra): thanks. i'll draft RFC with the sketch + billing appendix and link here when ready.

liam (runtime): +1, include a fallback compliance test and perf checklist.

omar (prod-eng): +1 from prod-eng, will coordinate the billing side and limits.

sasha (platform): tagging @everyone in eng-runtime: fyi this will affect Dedicated tenants' SLAs if we change burst budgets.
